offering_description.value: Designs, builds and sells single-family detached and attached homes, mainly entry-level and first move-up, to individual homebuyers. Builds on lots it acquires and develops, using subcontracted trades. Also offers mortgage, title and insurance services to buyers.

primary_products.value: single-family detached homes; attached townhomes and condominiums; developed residential lots

primary_services.value: mortgage financing; title and escrow services; homeowners insurance brokerage

customer_segment.value: B2C: entry-level and first move-up homebuyers

revenue_model.value: product sales: sale of newly built homes at closing; service fees: mortgage, title and insurance fees from homebuyers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: buys land, materials and subcontracted labor to build homes sold to homebuyers; financial intermediary: financial services arms provide title and mortgage services to its buyers

geography_served.value: US regional: Sun Belt and western states including Arizona, Texas, Florida, Georgia, the Carolinas, Tennessee, Colorado, Utah and Nevada

specialization.value: related lines: home building with related mortgage, title and insurance services

distribution_channels.value: own locations: sales offices and model homes in its communities; online: website listings and online home search; agents / brokers: outside real estate brokers who bring buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: land use, zoning, environmental and building codes, mortgage and title rules from CFPB and state regulators
